messages:
Iris Tan: quick heads-up: planning a stepped blue->green for router-edge v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 in the 03:15 UTC window. changes: new connection backoff + auth header normalization.
Diego Alvarez: ramp?
Iris Tan: 1% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100%. 5m holds on early steps, 15m watch on final. abort if 5xx > 2% sustained or p95 > 2x baseline for 10m.
Priya S.: session affinity is cookie. will add short pin post-cutover.
deploy-bot: preflight ok: green pool=5 nodes, infra health ok, config lint pass.
Iris Tan: posting release note to ops before first shift.
Priya S.: adding smoke test to ci:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://router-edge.internal/health -d '{"probe":"ok"}' | jq .status
```
Diego Alvarez: smoke passes on green. p50 11ms p95 39ms.
Iris Tan: starting 1% siphon in 90s. Diego watch LB metrics, Priya watch sessions.
deploy-bot: Step 1: shifted 1% to green (v2.4.0).
Diego Alvarez: p95 +2ms, errors unchanged.
Priya S.: affinity stable. new sessions=8. cache priming at 78%.
Iris Tan: moving to 10% in 6m if steady.
deploy-bot: Step 2: shifted 10% to green.
Diego Alvarez: small p95 bump to 55ms for ~30s then back to 42ms. 5xx spike 0.5% then settled.
Iris Tan: hold 5m. sounds acceptable.
Priya S.: extending session pin to 20m after full.
deploy-bot: Step 3: shifted 40% to green.
Diego Alvarez: noticing increased connection resets on node-4. investigating.
Iris Tan: pause! don't advance. Diego, can you drain node-4?
Diego Alvarez: draining node-4 now, restarting proxy. node-4 health ok after restart. connection resets dropped.
deploy-bot: node-4 restart recorded. healthchecks green.
Diego Alvarez: metrics back to baseline. errors 0.9% p95 48ms.
Iris Tan: given recovery, proceed slowly to 100% with 15m watch.
Priya S.: pin config-store to v2.4.0 for 30m post-shift.
deploy-bot: Step 4: shifted 100% to green. config-store pinned.
Diego Alvarez: p95 46ms, errors 1.1% stable.
Iris Tan: publishing short post-shift note and creating follow-up ticket to add pre-drain health checks for proxies. thanks all. :thumbsup:
